2607.24434.title: DraftExpert: Expansion-Aware Self-Speculative Decoding for End-Device MoE Inference
2607.24434.paper_summary: Large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models are attractive for end-device deployment because only a small subset of experts is active per token, but their routed expert weights often exceed accelerator memory. We target latency-critical single-user settings where routed experts are staged on demand from CPU memory to a GPU or from Flash to a mobile NPU. In this setting, self-speculative decoding faces a new bottleneck: increasing the draft expert set improves accuracy but triggers extra expert loading, while cheap small-footprint drafts have low acceptance; moreover, verifying a multi-token block activates the union of target experts and is no longer close to one target step. We propose DraftExpert, an expansion-aware self-speculative decoding framework for expert-offloaded MoE inference. DraftExpert trains one lightweight accelerator-resident draft expert per layer by self-distilling residual, logit/token, and router-agreement signals from the frozen target MoE. At inference time, it uses a fixed-footprint shared+top-1+draft-expert drafter together with confidence--expansion truncation and target-expert prefetching, while final tokens are still exactly verified by the target model. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Moonlight-16B-A3B across CPU-GPU and Flash-NPU offload, DraftExpert improves decode throughput by 1.45x on average, raises draft acceptance to 84~87%, and achieves 86~88% prefetch hit rates.
2607.24434.paper_summary_zh: 大型混合專家（MoE）語言模型在終端設備部署中具有吸引力，因為每個標記僅激活一小部分專家，但其路由專家的權重經常超過加速器內存。<lb/>我們針對延遲敏感的單用戶設置，將路由專家按需從 CPU 內存轉移到 GPU 或從 Flash 轉移到移動 NPU。<lb/>在這種情況下，自我推測解碼面臨一個新的瓶頸：增加草稿專家集可以提高準確性，但會觸發額外的專家加載，而便宜的小型草稿則接受度低；此外，驗證多標記區塊會激活目標專家的聯集，並且不再接近一個目標步驟。<lb/>我們提出了 DraftExpert，一種擴展感知的自我推測解碼框架，用於專家卸載的 MoE 推理。<lb/>DraftExpert 通過從凍結的目標 MoE 中自我蒸餾殘差、logit/token 和路由一致性信號，為每一層訓練一個輕量級的加速器常駐草稿專家。<lb/>在推理時，它使用固定佔用的共享+頂部-1+草稿專家草擬器，並結合信心擴展截斷和目標專家預取，同時最終標記仍然由目標模型精確驗證。<lb/>在 CPU-GPU 和 Flash-NPU 卸載的 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 和 Moonlight-16B-A3B 上，DraftExpert 平均提高了解碼吞吐量 1.45 倍，將草稿接受度提高到 84~87%，並實現 86~88% 的預取命中率。
2607.24434.author: Dengke Han et.al.
